# peakhour_image_transform (Resource)

Manages an image transform preset for a domain.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "peakhour_image_transform" "example" {
  domain = "example.com"
  name   = "thumbnail"

  config_json = jsonencode({
    w   = 200
    h   = 200
    fit = "crop"
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `config_json` (String) Transformation configuration as JSON string (e.g. '{"width": 800}'). Server-side defaults are ignored for drift detection.
- `domain` (String) Domain name.
- `name` (String) Preset name.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Image transform identifier (domain/uuid).
- `uuid` (String) Preset UUID (computed after creation).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import peakhour_image_transform.example example.com/11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111
```
